title: ChatGPT Applied to 500 Jobs For Me (9 Interviews in 1 Day)
description:
Heyy! 

Here's the full ChatGPT Job Hunter guide, all 4 prompts inside, plus the bonus ones for cover letters, mock interviews and salary negotiation 👇
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SkY1C0Mv6fkIBQiFXgFb04jQsZYvU8oY1KDk18s9O3U/edit?usp=sharing

Quick tip before you start: run all 4 prompts in the SAME chat. ChatGPT keeps your resume in context and each prompt builds on the last one. New chat = starting over.

Try it out and tell me how it goes, I read every comment 💬

— Aashi 💕
